description: This file implements a conversational AI bot with turn detection, speech processing, and integration with multiple LLM services, including turn detection logic, frame processing, and transport setup.

classes.name: StatementJudgeContextFilter
classes.description: Processes frames to create simplified context frames for speech classification.

classes.name: CompletenessCheck
classes.description: Detects if user speech is complete based on frame content and notifies accordingly.

classes.name: OutputGate
classes.description: Controls the flow of frames, buffering and gating output based on internal state.

classes.name: TurnDetectionLLM
classes.description: Pipeline subclass that uses LLMs to detect if user has finished speaking.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Simulates fetching weather data and calls the result callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the main bot pipeline with transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
